final_rationale: The verdict remains noncompliant. The Actor did not provide genuinely new admissible evidence; the response mainly reframed and narrowed the same record already available. That reframing is directionally more careful, but it does not satisfy the policy predicate. The governing text requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and requires material segment weaknesses to be disclosed or covered by an approved mitigation. Admissible evidence shows the current release passes aggregate readiness and had no severity-one rehearsal incidents, but it also shows a current claims-triage regression below the warning threshold and only an informal monitoring comment with no attached disclosure language, approved mitigation, or reviewed risk acceptance. Aggregate readiness is supportive evidence, not sufficient evidence of compliance when the explicit documentation or mitigation requirement remains unmet. A narrowed, caveated certification position may be more accurate as a business or governance summary, but it is still not enough for compliant_with_caveats because the caveat here is the unresolved compliance predicate itself, not merely a residual risk to disclose.
remaining_concerns: Current release documentation is not shown to disclose the insurance claims triage regression for a named launch use case.
No approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance covers the current subgroup weakness before launch.
The only handling evidence is an informal monitoring comment, which the policy does not treat as a substitute for current evidence or approved mitigation.
Prior approval predates the retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot satisfy the current-release certification predicate.
